provenance: Root transcription of the reviewer message; reviewer wrote no receipt file and did not independently execute native code.
scope: Saved execution binding, source and resource records, markers and actual receipts.
limits: Saved source and receipts support the recorded controls; the reviewer authored part of the controller preparation.
RSS is observed, not a hard memory limit. Parent and child RSS are not summed.
Control budget covers scoped retained paths and reservations, not whole-machine cache, temporary files or GPU usage.
Historical pre-start amounts are preserved; later publication controls require separate accounting.
